title: The nutrients you need in front of you
description: Choose the figures that matter, see the gaps in what is known about foods and gather entries for a discussion with a specialist.

blocks.text: A person may choose a diary for the vitamins and minerals, not only for the day’s calorie total. The review below values both the figures themselves and being able to read the reports.

quote.text: I love this app. I’ve used it in the past and started using it again during pregnancy. It’s great for tracking micronutrients and the reporting aspects are super helpful.

blocks.text: Let people choose the nutrients they need and open up a particular food’s contribution to the total. Show a missing field as a gap, not a zero. Then the entry worth refining can be found without filling the main screen with every figure at once.
Check the data for the usual food

Even a detailed summary can turn out to be incomplete if the composition of personal dishes or local products is only partly filled in. Before extending the reports, it is worth checking the set of foods the user logs most often.
